set.body: Measured a022 consumer callback still fails 4ms. One JFR diagnostic attributes all four captured backend samples to JavaFxSurfaceProbeResult.updatePreparedColors scalar getTexCoords comparison lines435–436. Preserve exact native array comparison, owner-thread writes, stale prepared guards, and mutation detection; replace per-element native accessor calls with bulk read and primitive comparison. Required correctness and unchanged consumer timing evidence before main adoption.
